Madrasah expenses/payment from Masjid Donation Funds. 4760 views Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 37627 Country: India Title: Could you please let me know if it is permissible to have shops on rent basis in the masjid building (in the entrance area or in any part of the masjid) and also if that amount (rent) could be used for covering the expenses of the Masjid Question: Could you please let me know if it is permissible to have shops on rent basis in the masjid building (in the entrance area or in any part of the masjid) and also if that amount (rent) could be used for covering the expenses of the Masjid. Answer ID: 37627 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 452/380/B=1433) The shops which are constructed separately from the boundary of the mosque they may be given on rent for the income of mosque. And the rent may be used to meet the expenses of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
